method: Single temporary loopback process, one shared model and FP32 codec, two separately captured graph sets. Selected clustered G32 control versus qualified eight-row down tile. Balanced AB/BA complete requests with identical text/reference/seed. Cached TTFA includes HTTP through first full 3840-byte PCM chunk. Fresh TTFA starts before reference-registration HTTP and includes following synthesis; WAV/base64 prepared beforehand. Fresh references are re-encoded, generated audio is never cached. One excluded warmup pair per workload.
